if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
then: the tax invoice MUST carry a consecutive serial number of at most sixteen characters, unique for the financial year
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(b), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: respectively, and any combination thereof, unique for a financial year;
